title: Snow-White and Rose-Red
description: Two sisters who share everything welcome a gentle bear into their winter home, then discover that their new friend is hiding a magical secret.
catalogueBlurb: Two kind sisters, a friendly bear and a secret hidden in the forest.
author: Brothers Grimm, retold by Quill

text.source: Original Story House retelling based on the Brothers Grimm public-domain tale and Margaret Hunt's 1884 translation
text.notes: The underlying Grimm tale and Margaret Hunt's 1884 English translation are public domain. This wording is an original child-friendly Unicorn Valley retelling.

illustrations.source: Otto Ubbelohde illustrations for Snow-White and Rose-Red, 1909
illustrations.notes: The selected Ubbelohde source files are identified as public domain on Wikimedia Commons. Ubbelohde died in 1922.

rights.curatorNotes: Split into five short reader sections. The original tale's harsher ending is softened for the target reader while preserving the central story and magical reveal.
